name: Agent
tagline: An AI agent you set up in plain words, powered by Claude.

commands.name: agent
commands.summary: An AI agent you set up in plain words.
commands.description: Set up an AI agent that replies and reacts in this server: its key, its instructions in plain words, when it replies and who it responds to, for the whole server or one channel, and what it remembers. Admins get all of it. Members get the memories they saved, if memory_access is everyone.

name: Config
tagline: Turn features on and pick the roles, channels and prefix they need.

commands.name: config
commands.summary: GBot's settings for this server. (admin only)
commands.description: Open this server's GBot settings: turn features on and off, pick the Storms and admin channels and the admin and Who Dis roles, change the prefix for prefix commands, and look up the reports on a member. (admin only)

name: GCoin
tagline: GBot's currency, carried across every server.

commands.name: gcoin
commands.summary: Your GCoin wallet, or someone else's.
commands.description: Show your GCoin wallet, or another member's: their balance and rank here, then send GCoin, see your transaction history, or see the ranking for this server and everywhere. Admins can also see other members' history.

name: GTrade
tagline: Craft image items and trade them.

commands.name: gtrade
commands.summary: Your items: craft, show off, sell and buy them.
commands.description: Open your items: craft one from an image link, show one off, rename it, destroy it for its value back, or sell it on this server's market or to one person. The market lists what's for sale here and the trade requests waiting on you.

name: Help
tagline: See what GBot can do in your server.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: See what GBot can do in this server.
commands.description: Lists only what is available in your server, names what is turned off, and shows a feature's commands when you pick one. Bare group commands like .config show the same detail.

name: Hype
tagline: Automatic replies and reactions to messages.

commands.name: hype
commands.summary: Manage automated replies and reactions to messages. (admin only)
commands.description: List, add, edit, delete and test this server's Hype matches: when a message matches a regular expression, GBot replies with one of its responses or reacts with one of its emoji, picked at random. (admin only)

name: Music
tagline: Play songs from YouTube in your voice channel.

commands.name: music
commands.summary: Play music from YouTube in your voice channel.
commands.description: Play a search, a YouTube link or a playlist in your voice channel, or open the now-playing card without one: pause, skip, stop, shuffle, loop the queue with elevator mode, add songs, move or remove queued ones, restart the song and follow someone's Spotify. Anyone in GBot's voice channel can press it.

commands.name: patreon
commands.summary: In the GBot Patreon server, specify your server's ID to enable GBot functionality. (patrons only)
commands.description: In the GBot Patreon server, specify a server's ID to enable GBot functionality in that server. (patrons only)

name: Reminders
tagline: Reminders in your own time zone, here or by DM.

commands.name: remind
commands.summary: Set a reminder, or see yours.
commands.description: Set a reminder for yourself, here or by DM, once, every day or every week, in your own time zone. With no fields it shows your reminders, where you can add, delete and change your time zone. Admins can also remind a role or everyone, and see everyone's reminders in this server. For a prefix command, quote anything with spaces: .remind "tomorrow 9am" "call the dentist"

name: Storms
tagline: Random number-guessing storms that pay out GCoin.

commands.name: storms
commands.summary: Guess the Storm's number to win GCoin.
commands.description: Storms roll into this server's Storms channel now and then: put up your umbrella to start one, then guess its number from 1 to 200, or bet GCoin on a guess, with a bigger win the fewer tries it takes. Your higher or lower hint is yours alone. With no number, it puts up your umbrella or says whether a Storm is on.

name: Who Dis
tagline: Chat anonymously with a random member and guess who it is.

commands.name: whodis
commands.summary: Chat anonymously with a random member, then guess who.
commands.description: Get paired with a random member for an anonymous chat in DMs, then guess who they are for a chance to win GCoin. Without a name it opens the card to start or end a game, or leave Who Dis. With one, in your DMs with GBot, it's your one guess.
